seo.title: Pricing: Free, Starter and Team plans
seo.description: TablePro is free to download and use. Starter and Team plans add optional features to the Mac app, billed monthly, yearly or once. Prices in US dollars.

og.title: Free to use. Paid plans add optional features.

header.title: Pricing
header.lead: Use the Mac app for free, with no trial period. Starter and Team add optional features. The iPhone and iPad app is free, with no in-app purchases.

features.title: What a paid plan adds
features.lead: Only the features listed here need a paid plan, currently on the Mac. Team includes Starter. All supported engines, the AI assistant, MCP and Safe Mode are free.

license.title: How licenses work

macs.body: Starter covers one person on up to {activations} Macs. Each Team seat covers one activated Mac, including the buyer’s. Two Macs use two seats. The iPhone and iPad app uses no license or seat.

activate.body: Enter your key in <ui>Settings > License</ui>. To move an activation, remove the old Mac from the Macs page in <account>your account</account>.

checks.body: TablePro verifies the license signature on launch and checks with its server every {revalidateDays} days. If the server is unreachable, paid features work for {graceDays} days after the last successful check. Checks send the key, a hashed machine ID, the Mac’s name and app and macOS versions.

ends.body: When a subscription ends, paid features stop. Everything in Free keeps working.

oneTime.body: A one-time purchase is paid once and has no expiry date.

lapse.summary: What each paid feature does when a plan ends
lapse.intro: Each paid feature stops in its own way:

license.terms: The <terms>terms of service</terms> set out what a license allows.

billing.title: Billing
billing.merchant: {merchant} is the merchant of record. It handles payment, calculates sales tax or VAT from your billing address, and emails receipts and invoices.
billing.renewal: Subscriptions renew until you cancel in <account>your account</account> or {merchant}’s portal. Access continues through the paid period; you can resume before it ends. Failed renewals trigger an email to update your card and payment retries for about three weeks.
billing.portal: Manage invoices, receipts, payment methods and cancellation in <portal>{merchant}’s customer portal</portal>. Sign in with your purchase email. <account>Billing & invoices</account> opens the same portal.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.body: Purchases and subscription renewals are refundable within {refundDays} days of each charge. Read the <link>refund policy</link> for the process and effect on your license.

team.title: Team plans
team.seats: A Team plan is priced per seat, from {min} to {max} seats.
team.invites: The buyer manages invitations in their account. Each code needs a free seat, works once and expires after a week.
team.changes: Change subscription seats in your account; the difference appears on your next invoice. For one-time purchases, email <email>{email}</email> to add seats.
team.account: Manage your team in your account

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: TablePro is open source under the AGPLv3, including the code for its paid features. A build from source checks the license the same way the released app does.
openSource.agpl: The AGPL places no conditions on running TablePro, including at work, in a company of any size. Its conditions apply to distributing it, and to offering a modified version to others over a network.

compare.title: Compared with other clients
compare.body: Compare prices and features with other clients. Each comparison includes a checked date and sources.

faq.title: Questions about plans
faq.more: More questions about plans and licenses

payment-methods.question: Which payment methods can I use?
payment-methods.answer: {merchant}’s checkout takes credit and debit cards.

company-invoice.question: Can I get an invoice for my company?
company-invoice.answer: Yes. In <portal>{merchant}’s customer portal</portal> you can add a company name, a VAT number and a billing address to an invoice, then download it.

lost-key.question: Where do I find my license key?
lost-key.answer: Find your key in the purchase email or <account>your account</account>. Sign in with your purchase email to see keys and activated Macs.
